scope: new bootstrap four-method static corridor seed260926001, old R2 behavior, no performance evidence

actual_offline_checks.render_new_seed: pass; only called render, never execute

findings.issue: Attempt directory is created before the exception/receipt boundary. Renderer, binding, git diff, port reservation, or ledger errors produce a partial identity without durable failed receipt.
findings.required: All operations after identity allocation must finalize a receipt with explicit preflight/not-started status. No automatic rerun of partial identity.

findings.issue: After leader exit, remaining process group receives SIGTERM without waiting, escalating, or verifying isolation ports. Cleanup can return while Gazebo children remain.
findings.required: Wait on actual owned group membership and identity, escalate to SIGKILL if needed, confirm no owned descendants/occupied ports before next row. Preserve final cleanup result.

findings.issue: Runtime dependency binding is incomplete: Python executable recorded as path only; no environment manifest/lock binding; omitted move_base and several Gazebo sensor/API plugin binaries; TEB runtime plugin path resolution not demonstrated.
findings.required: Bind environment manifest and actual executable/library/module provenance for this smoke, or explicitly mark incomplete closure and avoid a full dependency integrity pass.

findings.issue: If report exists after KeyboardInterrupt or wall timeout, status becomes completed; loop can start next method.
findings.required: Interruption/timeout remains a terminal queue reason regardless of report presence; finalize evidence and stop schedule.

findings.issue: Passive monitor death or no camera frames does not affect episode completion; all_four_completed is only report presence, not successful capture or simulation validation.
findings.required: Separate execution_complete, navigation_pass, capture_complete, machine_qc and human_qc. Do not claim smoke pass from all_four_completed alone.

findings.issue: Existing receipt is accepted without validating identity, bindings, report hash, or retained evidence.
findings.required: Validate recorded identity/evidence before idempotent reuse; never restart corrupted historical attempt.

findings.issue: Legacy spawn z=0.02 and repeated SetWorldPose may yield wheel bottom around +0.02m; QC correctly requires <=0.01m, so bootstrap may expose floating geometry.
findings.required: Measure live link/visual evidence, retain failed QC, introduce any physical correction under a new identity/version; do not loosen QC merely for pass.

findings.issue: Images retain exact sensor stamp and receipt-time model/link context separately, which is correct provenance; callback delay can make latest odom/scan newer than image and machine checks then fail.
findings.required: Do not claim exact synchronization from receipt-time states; use bounded timestamped queues or offline association for later stronger evidence.

limitations: Static review and pure render only; no live ROS launch or image observed.
